{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Compute conversion rate by customer_segment
# Conversion rate = number of converted orders / total orders in segment
conversion_rate_by_segment = df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Sort by conversion rate descending to find the highest
conversion_rate_by_segment_sorted = conversion_rate_by_segment.sort_values(ascending=False)

# Get the segment with the highest conversion rate
highest_segment = conversion_rate_by_segment_sorted.index[0]

# Print the conversion rates for all segments
print("Conversion rates by customer_segment:")
print(conversion_rate_by_segment_sorted)

# Return the highest segment
highest_segment"}
